observations: Photos 0 and 1 show one used petrol engine, inline four cylinder, standing in a parts shop.
Four coil-on-plug ignition coils sit in a row on an aluminium cam cover (photo 0).
Black oil filler cap reading 'OPEN ENGINE OIL' and a yellow dipstick handle (photo 0); no brand logo on it.
Alternator, belt pulleys and plastic intake manifold are attached (photo 1); some hoses and harness still on.
Casting text on the cam cover and a small label near the front of the block are present but not legible in either photo.
Exterior looks clean with light surface dirt; no engine code, displacement or VIN plate can be read.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE'.

identity.kind: used 4 cylinder petrol engine (make and engine code unread)

claims.evidence: No logo, engine code or label is legible in photos 0 or 1.
Photo 0 shows four ignition coils in a row on an inline cam cover.

risks.risk: Engine is not the Hyundai/Kia unit claimed, or is a smaller or different displacement than the buyer needs.
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the stamped engine code on the block and the cam cover casting text.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced for a specific engine; held until the code is read.

risks.risk: Engine does not run: low compression, knocking, burning oil or timing chain wear.
risks.proof: Clip of the engine running on a test stand or in the car before removal, with sound.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not running, a core engine for rebuild.

risks.risk: Water in oil or overheating damage (warped head, failed gasket).
risks.proof: Photo of the oil on the dipstick and under the filler cap.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a head gasket job.

risks.risk: Missing or faulty accessories and sensors (alternator, coils, harness, ECU not included).
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides listing what is included, plus the ECU if offered.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a bare long block.

proof_requests: Close photo of the stamped engine code on the block.
Clear photo of the cam cover casting text and any label.
Clip of the engine running, with sound.
Photo of the oil on the dipstick and under the filler cap.
Photos of all sides showing which accessories are included.
response.reason: The photos show a used inline four cylinder petrol engine, but the make and engine code, which set the price, are not legible anywhere and rest only on the seller's words. A shot of the engine code is needed before even a worst case price can be set.
